def get_sds_by_ip(self,ip):
        """
        Get ScaleIO SDS object by its ip address
        :param name: IP address of SDS
        :return: ScaleIO SDS object
        :raise KeyError: No SDS with specified ip found
        :rtype: SDS object
        """
        for sds in self.sds_list:
            if sds.ip == ip:
                return sds
        raise KeyError("No SDS with specified ip found")
